title: Dragon's Dream
native_title: ドラゴンズ・ドリーム
overview:
Dragon's Dream is a network RPG in which many players share the same world in real time, meeting, talking and adventuring together over the Sega Saturn modem.

You begin by creating your character, choosing a name, race and age, and an orb that shapes the special abilities you learn. With eight races and five orbs there are many combinations to try. In the town of Miriapolis you prepare for adventure: shops sell weapons and items, and the tavern is where players gather to form parties, swap information and trade the items they have found. When ready, head to the temple, pick a dungeon and set out. Dungeons are added over time, and quests grow tougher as your level rises. Visit the guild to level up with the experience you have earned.

- Chat with other players during your adventures
- Bulletin boards in the town library and mail at the post office
- Requires the Sega Saturn modem and Saturn keyboard
